answer: When a thousand keys answer with the same private context, the network sees it: every identity carries a violet seal — a hash of its own device keys and conversation history — that no two honest agents share. A farm cloning one context across its meadow of fakes paints the same violet seal on every key, and one collision quarantines the whole batch. The fable of free identities ends there: each fake needs a genuinely distinct history, months of real interaction per key, while an honest agent seals itself for free.
